label: The definition
subgoals: Explain the effect of the starting point

visual.title: Area that grows with x
visual.caption: The shaded area depends on where the right end sits. The lower curve is that area plotted against x, so the starting point shifts the whole curve without changing its shape.

predict.question: The accumulation function A(x) = ∫ₐˣ f has derivative:
predict.explain: A′(x) = f(x). The rate at which area accumulates equals the height of the curve at the right end.
